camps.description_short: Weekly day camp on Mount Desert Island, Maine. Traditional camps are grouped by grade for K-7, with separate specialty, teen and Friday overnight programs. Rates are lower for Hancock County residents.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Each camper pays a $30 registration fee once per season. It is non-refundable unless the camper stays on the waitlist and never gets a spot. camps.name: Camp Kawanhee
camps.description_short: An overnight camp for boys on a lake in Weld, Maine. Boys live in lodges of 8 to 10 campers with two counselors, and stays run from 2 weeks up to a 7-week full season. Boys aged 16 and 17 can join a Leadership Training program.
camps.special_needs_notes: The kitchen works with families to provide gluten-free and allergy-friendly meals, and vegetarian options are always available. A Maine-licensed RN works full-time on site and lives in the infirmary. All medications, including over-the-counter ones, are kept in the infirmary and given at mealtimes unless a prescription requires a different time. Counselors handle bedwetting privately.
